perplexity.description:
Ronnie Barker's Unbroken British Record is a comedy album released in 1978 on the K-Tel label (catalogue NE1029). The album features Barker performing comedic sketches and musical parodies, including material such as "Irish Medley: I'll Have a Drink with You," "Thump Thump," and "It Pays to Listen." As a Stage & Screen release, the album represents Barker's work outside his primary medium of television, capturing his distinctive comedic style in audio form during the height of his career.

The album emerged during a prolific period for Barker, who was simultaneously starring in the BBC television series The Two Ronnies with Ronnie Corbett. K-Tel's involvement as the label indicates the album was positioned as a commercial release aimed at the broader comedy album market of the late 1970s, rather than as a specialized or niche recording. The specific reception and chart performance of the album remain undocumented in available sources, though its release through a major compilation label suggests it reached a mainstream audience during the period.
